prior_exposure: All submitted and reviewer-driven canine and MedMNIST+ test results were known.

An internal pre-upload review had named unexplored dense-filter weight decay and the short optimizer-step budget of the two small external datasets as open explanations; the revised text stating both as untested was written before these runs.

questions.wd: Does the validation-selected PSAN advantage over the matched dense control persist when the dense filter receives the weight decay of its training setting?
questions.steps: Does the PSAN-control contrast on BloodMNIST and corrected DermaMNIST change when the fixed c2 recipe is trained for as many optimizer steps as a 30-epoch canine run?

common.sampler: inverse-square-root class weights, replacement, one training-set size of draws per epoch
common.test: evaluated once after validation selection; never used for selection

wd.screening: 8 epochs at seed 42, no early stopping, training/validation data only
wd.selection: highest best validation Macro F1; ties to the earlier candidate
wd.difference: filter_real and filter_imag of the twelve dense filters move from the no-decay group to the decay group; architecture, initialization, data, sampler, schedule and selection rule are unchanged

steps.short_schedule_counterparts: results/round7/support/final/{dataset}_{arm}_f100_c2_s{seed}_final (30 epochs, 3 warm-up epochs; otherwise the same recipe, data order and initialization)

statistics.resampling: crossed bootstrap of test groups (visual groups for canine, lesions for corrected Derma, images for Blood) and the three seed indices; 95% percentile intervals, unadjusted

families.wd: 3 Holm-adjusted contrasts: dense with filter decay minus dense; PSAN (AD 0.2) minus dense with filter decay; PSAN (AD 0) minus dense with filter decay
families.steps_simple: per dataset, 2 Holm-adjusted contrasts at the step-matched schedule: PSAN (AD 0) minus matched dense and minus free rank-16
families.steps_interaction: per dataset, 2 Holm-adjusted contrasts: (PSAN minus control) at the step-matched schedule minus the same contrast at 30 epochs

statistics.all_runs: every screening trial, final run and contrast is reported; no outcome-based extension or exclusion

replay: results/round9/checks/replay.json: first epoch of three archived runs reproduced by this code before freezing
